Alert.level_1: Gain Notice. Can't be surprised or targeted by Execution Attacks; +1 to your side's initiative (or roll individual init twice).
Alert.level_2: You always act first in a round unless another combatant is equally Alert.

Armored Magic.level_1: Cast spells/use arts in armor of Encumbrance 2 or less; may use a shield if your other hand is free to gesture.
Armored Magic.level_2: Cast in armor of any Encumbrance, and even with both hands full (not bound).

Armsmaster.level_1: Gain Stab. Ready a stowed melee/thrown weapon as an Instant; add Stab skill to melee/thrown damage or Shock. (Doesn't stack with Deadeye.)
Armsmaster.level_2: Your melee Shock treats targets as AC 10; +1 to hit with thrown/melee attacks.

Artisan.level_1: Gain Craft. Craft counts as one level higher (max 5) for mods, which cost one less salvage; Craft works for any crafting profession.
Artisan.level_2: First mod on an item is free of Maintenance and half-cost; auto-succeed at masterwork gear; monthly extra salvage reduction.

Assassin.level_1: Gain Sneak. Conceal a knife-sized object, draw it On Turn; point-blank surprise-round attacks with it can't miss.
Assassin.level_2: Take a (splittable) Move action on the same round as an Execution Attack, closing without alerting the victim.

Authority.level_1: Gain Lead. Once/day, a Cha/Lead check vs an NPC's Morale makes them comply with a not-harmful request.
Authority.level_2: NPCs you directly lead gain +Lead to Morale and hit rolls and +1 to skill checks; followers won't act against you.

Close Combatant.level_1: Gain any combat skill. Use knife-sized thrown weapons in melee freely; ignore melee Shock (but doing so disrupts your casting that round).
Close Combatant.level_2: Your melee Shock treats all targets as AC 10; Fighting Withdrawal becomes a free On Turn action for you.

Connected.level_1: Gain Connect. After a week somewhere not hostile, you have contacts for mildly-illegal favors — one favor/game day.
Connected.level_2: Once/session, plausibly run into someone you know willing to do a modest favor (GM decides who).

Cultured.level_1: Gain Connect. Speak all common regional languages; learn a new one in a week; once/day gain a minor no-cost favor from a non-hostile NPC.
Cultured.level_2: Once/session, reroll a failed social skill check using your cultural knowledge.

Die Hard.level_1: +2 max HP per level (retroactive). Auto-stabilize when Mortally Wounded unless torn apart.
Die Hard.level_2: The first time each day an injury would drop you to 0 HP, you survive at 1 HP instead.

Deadeye.level_1: Gain Shoot. Ready a stowed ranged weapon as an Instant; use a bow in melee at -4; add Shoot skill to ranged damage.
Deadeye.level_2: Reload slow weapons On Turn; use any ranged weapon in melee without penalty; once/scene auto-hit an inanimate target.

Dealmaker.level_1: Gain Trade. In half an hour, find a buyer/seller for any tradeable good or service in the community, legal or not.
Dealmaker.level_2: Once/session, make a request of a non-hostile sentient; if plausible, they'll deal for a price or favor.

Developed Attribute.level_1: Raise one attribute's modifier by +1 (max +3); the score is unchanged. May be taken multiple times for different attributes.

Diplomatic Grace.level_1: Gain Convince. Speak all common regional languages (learn new in a week, fluent in a month); reroll 1s on negotiation/diplomacy dice.
Diplomatic Grace.level_2: Once/day, consecrate a bargain; the other party must Mental save to break it (most NPCs won't try). Must be specific and time-limited.

Gifted Chirurgeon.level_1: Gain Heal. Stabilize one adjacent Mortally Wounded person/round On Turn; roll Heal checks 3d6-drop-lowest; double post-battle first aid healing.
Gifted Chirurgeon.level_2: Your healing counts as magical: heal 1d6 + Heal to an adjacent ally as a Main action (+1 Strain), reviving without Frailty.

Henchkeeper.level_1: Gain Lead. Recruit loyal henchmen (one per 3 levels) within a day of arriving; they escort and risk danger but won't fight except to save themselves.
Henchkeeper.level_2: Henchmen will fight for you (treated as Veteran Soldiers); capable NPCs can become henchmen if you've earned their loyalty.

Impervious Defense.level_1: Innate Armor Class of 15 + half your level (round up). Doesn't stack with armor, but Dex and shield modifiers apply.
Impervious Defense.level_2: Once/day, as an Instant, shrug off a single weapon attack or physical trauma (not environmental/falling damage).

Impostor.level_1: Gain Perform or Sneak. Once/scene reroll a failed disguise/imposture check; hold one flawless minor false identity.
Impostor.level_2: Swap between three chosen appearances with a Main action; establish a new false identity in each community you spend a day in.

Lucky.level_req: An attribute modifier of -1 or worse
Lucky.level_1: Once/week, a blow or effect that would kill, Mortally Wound, or disable you simply fails. Roll games of chance twice, take the better.
Lucky.level_2: Once/session in peril, roll 1d6: on 2+ something fortunate happens; on a 1 the situation gets much worse.

Nullifier.level_1: You and allies within 20' get +2 saves vs magic; sense magic within 20' On Turn; your first failed save vs magic each day becomes a success.
Nullifier.level_2: Once/day, as an Instant, be simply unaffected by an unwanted magical effect or monstrous power, even one with no save.

Poisoner.level_1: Gain Heal. Reroll failed saves vs poison; brew toxins (one dose/level) dealing 2d6 + level on a hit/Shock, Physical save for half.
Poisoner.level_2: Immune to poison; universal antidote; -Heal penalty to detect/save vs your poisons; ingested poisons count as Execution Attacks.

Polymath.level_1: Gain any one skill. Treat all non-combat skills as at least level-0 for checks, even ones you lack. (Phantom levels don't stack/discount.)
Polymath.level_2: Treat all non-combat skills as at least level-1 for checks.

Rider.level_1: Gain Ride. Your steeds count as Morale 12, use your AC if better, and travel 50% further/day; intuitively communicate with riding beasts.
Rider.level_2: Once/scene negate an attack on your steed (Instant); reroll a failed Ride check; telepathic link with a bonded steed within 200'.

Shocking Assault.level_1: Gain Punch or Stab. Your weapon's Shock treats all targets as AC 10 (if it can harm them and they aren't Shock-immune).
Shocking Assault.level_2: +2 to the Shock rating of all melee/unarmed attacks that do Shock.

Sniper's Eye.level_1: Gain Shoot. On a ranged Execution Attack or target-shooting, roll the skill check 3d6-drop-lowest.
Sniper's Eye.level_2: Don't miss ranged Execution Attacks; the target takes -4 on the Physical save and double damage even on a success.

Special Origin.level_req: GM permission; pick a species origin
Special Origin.level_1: Take the origin Focus for a non-human species (from the bestiary) to play that demihuman/alien kind, gaining its listed benefits.
Special Origin.level_2: (Varies by chosen origin — see the bestiary entry.)

Specialist.level_1: Gain any skill (not Magic/Stab/Shoot/Punch). Roll 3d6-drop-lowest for all checks in it. May be taken for different skills.
Specialist.level_2: Roll 4d6-drop-two-lowest for all checks in this skill.

Spirit Familiar.level_1: Gain a loyal familiar (cat- to human-sized) with Evoked Servitor stats, summon/dismiss as a Main action; once/day it refreshes one Committed Effort.
Spirit Familiar.level_2: Pick two upgrades (extra HP, an attack, a skill bonus, a second shape, flight, or speech). Repeatable for two more each time.

Trapmaster.level_1: Gain Notice. Once/scene reroll a failed trap-related save/check; improvise a trap (non-lethal lose-a-round, or lethal 1d6 + 2x level) in 5 minutes.
Trapmaster.level_2: Once/scene, your efforts count as Extirpate Arcana (cast as a Mage of twice your level) against a magical trap or hazard.

Unarmed Combatant.level_1: Gain Punch. Unarmed damage scales with Punch (1d6 at L0 up to 1d12+1 at L4) with Shock = Punch skill vs AC 15; bind ranged-weapon foes.
Unarmed Combatant.level_2: Even on a missed Punch, deal an unmodified 1d6 plus any Shock the blow would inflict.

Unique Gift.level_1: A catch-all special power defined by player and GM together, worth one Focus pick; revisable if it proves too weak or strong.

Valiant Defender.level_1: Gain Stab or Punch. +2 to Screen Ally checks, screen one more attacker, and once/round screen even spells/area effects (vs the attacker's Magic).
Valiant Defender.level_2: Your first Screen Ally check each round auto-succeeds; +2 AC while screening; screen foes as large as ogres or oxen.

Well Met.level_1: Reaction rolls get +1 while you're present; even hostile beings usually grant a round of parley first. Works once per target.
Well Met.level_2: Once/session, make a subject as friendly and helpful as plausibly possible when a reaction roll is made.

Whirlwind Assault.level_1: Gain Stab. Once/scene, as an On Turn action, apply your Shock damage to all foes in melee range susceptible to it.
Whirlwind Assault.level_2: The first time you kill someone in a round with a normal attack, instantly gain a second attack on any target in range.

Xenoblooded.level_1: Pick one alien-heritage benefit: heat/smoke immunity; water-adaptation; heavy/light-gravity attribute shift; or need no food/sleep/air + see in the dark.
Xenoblooded.level_2: (No second level — a single heritage benefit.)

Mundane Alchemist.effect: Atlas optional Focus (Experts only): grants the Alchemy skill and basic formulae to brew lesser/greater alchemical works.

Legate Writs.effect: Legate-tier powers (Writs of Might/Skill/Sorcery/Mastery), fueled by Legate Effort, undispellable and undetectable. Begin with Legate's Impunity + Legate's Wrath. See ch. 13 for the full Writ list.

Ghost Archer Style.level_req: Warriors / Partial Warriors only; only one style may be learned.
Ghost Archer Style.level_1: Gain Shoot. -4 to hit with non-bow/crossbow weapons. On Turn: manifest a 0-encumbrance spirit copy of any bow you've ever fired (it makes its own ammunition with no bonus); fire it even when meleed. Only you can manifest a copied bow.
Ghost Archer Style.level_2: Once/scene, On Turn, shoot an arrow anywhere in range and instantly appear where it lands (gain 1 System Strain).

All Directions Edge Style.level_req: Warriors / Partial Warriors only; only one style may be learned.
All Directions Edge Style.level_1: Gain a combat skill. Your hit die is penalized by 2 (e.g. 1d6+2 becomes 1d6; lose 2 max HP/level if taken later). On Turn, once/round, make a normal non-grappling attack; after the first use each day, extra uses cost 1 System Strain.
All Directions Edge Style.level_2: Once/day, as a Main Action, attack every enemy within range once (ranged max = Shoot skill + 1).

One Point Strike Style.level_req: Warriors / Partial Warriors only; only one style may be learned.
One Point Strike Style.level_1: Gain a combat skill. All your attacks use the better of your Int or Wis modifier. As a Main Action, make a melee attack that does minimum damage but whose hit roll is automatically a 15 (not usable for maneuvers/grapples).
One Point Strike Style.level_2: Once/scene, as an Instant, a melee hit made with this style has its weapon damage maximized.

Pyre of Heaven Style.level_req: Warriors / Partial Warriors only; only one style may be learned.
Pyre of Heaven Style.level_1: Gain a combat skill. Ignore the first 5 fire/heat damage/round and glow at will. Instant (+1 System Strain): ignite your weapon/fist/ammo for the round, gaining +level+2 damage and Shock (each foe takes the bonus only once/scene).
Pyre of Heaven Style.level_2: As level 1, plus immunity to non-magical flame/smoke; your whole body ignites (harming only intended targets) and you can't be grappled while ignited. First ignition each scene deals 1d6 fire/3 levels (round up) to all foes in melee.

Catalytic Soul Style.level_req: Warriors / Partial Warriors only; only one style may be learned.
Catalytic Soul Style.level_1: Gain Shoot. Works only with ranged attacks lacking Shock. Your shots pass harmlessly through allies. On a ranged attack, Instant: nominate an ally in melee with your target; the target suffers Shock as if melee-attacked by that ally.
Catalytic Soul Style.level_2: When you hit a target with a level-1-boosted ranged attack, you or the ally may gain 1 System Strain to heal 2d6 + the target's level/HD (a given subject heals only once/scene this way).

Wrathful Mountain Style.level_req: Warriors / Partial Warriors only; only one style may be learned.
Wrathful Mountain Style.level_1: Gain Stab or Punch. -2 to all hit rolls. Instant: manifest a 0-encumbrance magical large shield usable even with both hands full, persisting at will. Once/round, when a Screened ally is meleed, make an Instant melee attack on the attacker first.
Wrathful Mountain Style.level_2: Your retaliation also strikes those making ranged attacks on your Screened ally, at any distance. Instant (+1 System Strain): for the round, retaliate against every enemy attacking your ward (once/foe/round).

Righteous Iron Style.level_req: Warriors / Partial Warriors only; only one style may be learned.
Righteous Iron Style.level_1: Gain Exert. Benefits apply only in heavy armor. Worn armor gains +1 AC and 0 encumbrance (still counts for Armored Magic); armor no longer penalizes Sneak/Exert; sleep comfortably in it. If taken at L1, begin play with free heavy armor worth up to 750 sp.
Righteous Iron Style.level_2: While armored, you need not eat, drink, sleep, or breathe and ignore normal heat/cold; the armor AC bonus becomes +2.

World Tree Lance Style.level_req: Warriors / Partial Warriors only; only one style may be learned.
World Tree Lance Style.level_1: Gain Stab. Works only with spears/pikes/polearms. Your spear has 0 encumbrance, always returns when thrown, doubled thrown ranges (or 30/60 ft if not normally throwable), and +1 to hit and damage as a magic weapon.
World Tree Lance Style.level_2: While wielding a spear, your melee reach is 10 ft + your level; intervening allies don't hinder your attacks (a wall of enemy bodies might). Does not stack with the Long magic-weapon property.

Master Tracker.level_req: Full or Partial Experts only; only one Godblood Focus (attribute boosts cap at +2).
Master Tracker.level_1: Gain Survive. Follow any trail made within a day (city) or week (wilderness), ignoring weather/water; read the number, shape, and condition of those who passed.
Master Tracker.level_2: +1 Wis modifier. Identify specific people by their tracks if you've met them; once/day reconstruct the general actions of a scene from the past week.

Night Walker.level_req: Full or Partial Experts only; only one Godblood Focus (attribute boosts cap at +2).
Night Walker.level_1: Gain Sneak. See normally in all but pitch blackness; even blinded, sense your surroundings out to 30 ft; sleep as light as wakefulness, waking at will.
Night Walker.level_2: +1 Dex modifier. Unless lit by torchlight or brighter, you are effectively invisible until you draw attention.

Danger Sense.level_req: Full or Partial Experts only; only one Godblood Focus (attribute boosts cap at +2).
Danger Sense.level_1: Gain Notice. Sense Execution Attacks on you or those present in time to spoil them; once/day, sense a trap/ambush/peril in time to stop the action.
Danger Sense.level_2: +1 Wis modifier. Once/day, as an Instant in danger, intuit the best course to escape with minimum losses.

Pack Beast.level_req: Full or Partial Experts only; only one Godblood Focus (attribute boosts cap at +2).
Pack Beast.level_1: Gain Exert. Treat your Strength as 18 for encumbrance (22 if already 18).
Pack Beast.level_2: +1 Str modifier. Once/scene, On Turn, lift and move an object up to 1,000 lb, setting it down by end of turn.

Folie a Deux.level_req: Full or Partial Experts only; only one Godblood Focus (attribute boosts cap at +2).
Folie a Deux.level_1: Gain Convince. Lies never register as false (magic reads you as sincere); once/day make a listener believe you are absolutely sincere until evidence disproves it (a target is immune after the first disproven lie).
Folie a Deux.level_2: +1 Cha modifier. Once/day, tell a bald lie; unless impossible/intolerable, the listener makes a Mental save (penalty = your Convince) or believes it 1d4 rounds.

Provident Crafter.level_req: Full or Partial Experts only; only one Godblood Focus (attribute boosts cap at +2).
Provident Crafter.level_1: Gain Craft. Treat your Strength as 4 higher for encumbrance; gear you need for a check or item use counts as Readied even if Stowed.
Provident Crafter.level_2: +1 Dex modifier. Once/day, as an Instant, you happen to have Stowed a normal <=2-encumbrance item you could have bought/made in the past week (pay its price; not provisions; not the same item twice a week).

Wildtongue.level_req: Full or Partial Experts only; only one Godblood Focus (attribute boosts cap at +2).
Wildtongue.level_1: Gain Survive. Communicate simple ideas with animals (natural or magical beasts of bestial intellect); appeased ones may do basic immediate favors.
Wildtongue.level_2: +1 Cha modifier. Once/day, command a visible animal for one scene to obey even complex non-suicidal orders (magical beasts get a Mental save).

Walk Like Wind.level_req: Full or Partial Experts only; only one Godblood Focus (attribute boosts cap at +2).
Walk Like Wind.level_1: Gain Exert. +10 ft base ground movement; move up or down vertical surfaces so long as you end on a flat surface or handhold.
Walk Like Wind.level_2: +1 Dex modifier. Leap 20 ft horizontally or 10 ft vertically as a Move; once/scene, On Turn, gain a bonus Move action.

Atlantean Divination.level_req: Mages / Partial Mages only; only one Arcane Secret Focus (single level).
Atlantean Divination.level_1: Gain Know. Spend an hour in ritual to ask one one-sentence question about a future event within a week (GM rolls Int/Know vs difficulty 9 secretly; success = a true few-word answer, failure = a plausible false oracle). No repeats; each use within 7 days adds +1 difficulty; +1 System Strain/use.
Atlantean Divination.level_2: (No second level — Arcane Secret Foci are single-level by rule.)

Iteral Pacting.level_req: Mages / Partial Mages only; only one Arcane Secret Focus (single level).
Iteral Pacting.level_1: Gain Pray. Pick a patron portfolio (core p.142). Once/day, +1 System Strain for one of: +4 to a hit roll, +1 to a skill check, or cast a portfolio-related 1st-level spell as a Main Action (no prepared spell/slot, even for non-casters). -1 to non-intimidation social checks.
Iteral Pacting.level_2: (No second level — Arcane Secret Foci are single-level by rule.)

Nagadi Hemomancy.level_req: Mages / Partial Mages only; only one Arcane Secret Focus (single level).
Nagadi Hemomancy.level_1: Gain Heal. Once/day, as an Instant after casting a (non-harmful, willing-target) spell, take 1d4 damage per spell level so the casting doesn't count against your usable spells/day; +1 System Strain/use.
Nagadi Hemomancy.level_2: (No second level — Arcane Secret Foci are single-level by rule.)

Old Empire Sigilism.level_req: Mages / Partial Mages only; only one Arcane Secret Focus (single level).
Old Empire Sigilism.level_1: Embed one spell at a time in a personal token-calyx (10 min/spell level + a daily spell use, recoverable). Using it is a Main Action needing only a firm presentation (no voice/gestures) and cannot be disrupted by damage.
Old Empire Sigilism.level_2: (No second level — Arcane Secret Foci are single-level by rule.)

Vothite Mind-Sorcery.level_req: Mages / Partial Mages only; only one Arcane Secret Focus (single level).
Vothite Mind-Sorcery.level_1: Your spellcasting needs no vocalization or gestures (still a Main Action, still disruptable by damage, still no casting in armor for most), and hides its source. You can no longer cast spells that deal non-mental HP damage.
Vothite Mind-Sorcery.level_2: (No second level — Arcane Secret Foci are single-level by rule.)

Choeru Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Choeru Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Convince or Connect. +1 Cha modifier; +1 to reaction rolls made in your presence; gain serviceable fluency in any language after a week of exposure.
Choeru Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Ghoul.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Ghoul.level_1: Must eat a pound of human flesh a month. Gain Sneak, the benefits of Ghoulish Vigor, and +1 to your Str or Dex modifier. After 21 days without cannibalism, make a Mental save daily or attack the nearest human to devour them; automatic after 30 days.
Ghoul.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

!Man.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
!Man.level_1: Pick any skill but Magic. Once/day, as an Instant, your algorithm grants +1 to a skill check or +2 to hit. Immune to mind-affecting magic; otherwise a perfectly normal human (not an automaton).
!Man.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Guer Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Guer Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Notice or Sneak. +1 to your Wis or Cha modifier; see clearly in low light; +10 ft ground movement.
Guer Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Accipiter Anak.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Accipiter Anak.level_1: Gain Exert. You are an accipiter with the Accipiter Flight ability; -1 Con modifier and +1 Dex modifier.
Accipiter Anak.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Harbinger Anak.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Harbinger Anak.level_1: Gain Sneak or Convince and the Harbinger's Face ability. +1 Cha modifier and -1 Con modifier.
Harbinger Anak.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Aristoi Anak.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Aristoi Anak.level_1: Gain Lead and any one other non-Magic skill. +1 Wis modifier; use Wis as the attribute for any weapon in place of Str or Dex.
Aristoi Anak.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Hua Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Hua Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Exert. +1 Str modifier and -1 Dex modifier; treat Str as 4 higher for encumbrance; +2 to your maximum System Strain.
Hua Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Kitsune Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Kitsune Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Notice or Convince. +1 Cha modifier; gain the Elemental Sparks Elementalist art (or a bonus Elementalist art if you already have it).
Kitsune Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Deepfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Deepfolk.level_1: See clearly in any light; need half the food, water, and air of a baseline; raise one physical attribute to 14 if lower. Exposing eyes/skin to direct sunlight forces a Physical save each round or +1 System Strain (collapsing if over max).
Deepfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Manu Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Manu Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Exert or Survive. +1 Con or Str modifier and -1 Dex or Cha modifier; swim at full speed; hold breath 15 minutes; reduce all Shock taken by 1 (min 1).
Manu Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Nahu Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Nahu Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Sneak or Notice. +1 Dex or Cha modifier; claws count as daggers; see clearly in low light. In real combat, make a Mental save to deal non-lethal damage or the attack is lethal.
Nahu Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Oni.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Oni.level_1: Gain Stab or Punch. +1 Str modifier and count Str 4 higher for encumbrance; -1 Wis modifier and -2 on all Mental saving throws.
Oni.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Pichi Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Pichi Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Notice. +1 Wis or Dex modifier and -1 Str or Con modifier; see normally in low light; interact with objects within 10 ft as if sighted even when blinded.
Pichi Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Piren Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Piren Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Exert. Once/scene, as a Move action, give an adjacent ally a bonus Main Action for a physical act (not casting); a given ally benefits once/scene.
Piren Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Still Cities Undead.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Still Cities Undead.level_1: You are undead: no need to eat, sleep, drink, or breathe (but need 8 hours of quiet to recover HP/spells/Effort). Immune to poison and disease; auto-stabilize at 0 HP unless mangled. You don't count as undead for conventional Necromancer spells.
Still Cities Undead.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Sui Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Sui Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Survive. +1 Con modifier; immune to mundane poisons; once/day, act for one full round after dropping to 0 HP (unless mangled; counts against your stabilization timer).
Sui Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Tanuki Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Tanuki Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Sneak. Climb scalable surfaces at full movement; once/day, as a Main Action, transform as with Adopt the Simulacular Visage (without its language powers) for up to 2 hours/level.
Tanuki Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Tengu Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Tengu Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Stab. Fly at 30 ft outdoors at normal encumbrance, but interiors are too cramped and you cannot fight or act complexly while flying or use it for long travel.
Tengu Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Usagi Beastfolk.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Usagi Beastfolk.level_1: Gain Exert or Sneak and +1 to all saving throws. +1 Dex modifier and -1 Str or Con modifier. Once/scene, On Turn, double your ground movement for the round; once/week, as an Instant, automatically make a Luck save.
Usagi Beastfolk.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)

Zakathi.level_req: GM permission; a non-human origin (single level; attribute shifts cap at +2/-2).
Zakathi.level_1: Gain Exert. Raise Con to 14 if lower (to 18 if already 14+); +2 maximum System Strain. You must exhaust yourself daily to recover with rest, else gain 1 System Strain overnight (dying if over max); while exhausted, roll all hit/skill rolls twice and take the worst.
Zakathi.level_2: (Single-level origin Focus — see the Bestiary entry for special abilities.)
